### Base Camp Bundle — $199.99

One Sentinel 1000 and two Firefly 220 lanterns in one box, for a household that wants one big
light for the main room and two small ones for bedrooms. Bought separately the three lanterns
cost $219.97, so the bundle saves $19.98. The Firefly 220s come in slate. Each lantern carries its
own warranty: 5 years on the Sentinel, 2 years on each Firefly. A bundle can be returned only as a
whole; one lantern from a bundle cannot be returned on its own.

[5] faq.md > What is the difference between the Firefly 220 and the Firefly 220R?
### What is the difference between the Firefly 220 and the Firefly 220R?

They are the same size and give the same 220 lumens. The Firefly 220 ($34.99) runs on three AA
batteries, which are included, for 42 hours on low or 9 hours on high. The Firefly 220R ($54.99)
has a built-in 2,600 mAh rechargeable battery that charges over USB-C, runs 48 hours on low or 10
hours on high, and can charge a phone from its USB-A port. The 220R weighs 30 grams more.
